rationale: RSD1/RSD3/RSD4 pins (2026-09-05, cargo+ripgrep census): (1) qualified_calls used to be keyed by BARE method name in a qcByFunction map — Alpha.run and Beta.run shared one payload (410 buckets / 749 excess entries across the corpus); each method must now carry ONLY its own body's calls. (2) `struct Alpha` + multiple `impl Alpha` blocks all produced symbol id 'Alpha' (2,852 duplicates in 271 files) — ids must be unique per declaration. (3) macro invocations are real call sites (calls edges exist) but never reached the payload — a format!-only method must carry `macro:format`. SUPERSESSION (2026-10-19, Lead decision §21.11 task-36 defect 1, task-9 conditions): impl symbols used to be named `Alpha` (ids Alpha#2/#3), i.e. a duplicate declaration of the struct. The impl block is a CONTAINER with the distinct identity `Alpha::r#impl`; the three blocks still get three DISTINCT ids (Alpha::r#impl, Alpha::r#impl#2, Alpha::r#impl#3), which is exactly the RSD3 intent this fixture exists for — the duplicate NAME identity is now forbidden.
